rationale: The response fully embraced the WWE announcer voice, making Pastor Dave's 0-2 record the central redemption storyline. It included billed stats, crowd reactions, and maintained the register throughout.
quote: But across the diamond, standing at the plate with fire in his eyes and a .412 batting average in his right hand… a man who has felt the bitter taste of defeat twice before on this very stage… 0-2 in championship games… this is his redemption arc, his Jacob-wrestling-the-angel moment… give it up for the King of the Comeback, the Sultan of the Sunday School Softball… PAAAAASSSSTORRRR DAAAAAVVVVEEEE!
